environment.browser: user's own Chrome, logged in to Gemini, zh-CN UI, account with a Google One subscription
environment.method: opencli browser sessions; page operated by DOM clicks and fill; responses read from OpenCLI network capture; no request was constructed by the probe

redaction: No cookies, tokens, account identity, conversation ids, or other conversation titles are recorded. Sizes are response body characters as reported by OpenCLI.
prompt: Compare actively maintained Rust crates for converting HTML to Markdown as of October 2026 (for example htmd, html2md, fast_html2md, mdka): maintenance status, fidelity for tables, code blocks and links, performance, and license. Recommend one for a CLI tool that converts fetched web pages to Markdown.
